patches.description: Return false from the virtual-input setting read
patches.rationale: The 4.41.1.2335 setting-read sequence exactly matches the reviewed 4.39 behavior at a new unique offset. This experimental test keeps settings refresh from re-enabling the unavailable gvinput driver path.

patches.description: Store false in the runtime virtual-input setter
patches.rationale: At this unique 4.41.1.2335 target, movzx esi,dl feeds the byte stored through r14. The same-length xor esi,esi; nop replacement forces that runtime value false for this isolated startup test.

experimental.scope: An isolated, prefix-only local sign-in UI startup experiment on Ubuntu 26.04. It deliberately does not assemble the RDP relay runtime.
experimental.known_limitation: The 4.39 constructor patch could not be semantically re-established for 4.41. This manifest intentionally omits it and must never be promoted to an approved release without full behavioral validation.

audit.warning: This is an explicit opt-in experimental manifest, not an approved release.
